messages:
riley: Planning a config-only push for change window tonight 21:30 PT. cfg id cfg-7975312345. Changes: tighten per-tenant timeouts, adjust routing.weights to favor new replicas, and reduce tinybatch.window. Canary plan: staged 5% -> 15% over 20m with validation gates.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by riley — canary 5% for 10m (us,apac). Rollout id cfg-7975312345. Observability: https://dash/reports/cfg-7975312345. Release notes draft: https://docs/releases/7975312345 (add to blurb after merge).

anj: Ack. Running quick smoke: 30 synthetic hits apac / us, check 5xx, 99p, kv-cache seed_miss. Pause if 5xx > 0.3% or 99p > 750ms.

mike: Suggest pin model to v1.4-stable to avoid cache layout mismatch. Also add an ops flag to route affected tenants to dedicated fallback pool if tail latencies climb.

riley: Applied: model.pin=v1.4-stable, routing.weights adjust to +7% new replicas, tinybatch.window 50ms -> 30ms, timeout.per_request background 16s -> 11s, fallback.route=dedicated-pool for vip tenants.

deploy-bot: Canary started (5%). Commands: `/deploybot pause cfg-7975312345` or `/deploybot rollback cfg-7975312345`. Logs: `kubectl -n infra logs -f deploy/cfg-7975312345`.

ops-bot: Alert: apac-sg 99p spiked to 980ms at +4m. Seed_miss for kvcache increased for tenant-apac-retail.

anj: Pulling canary to 2% and pausing automated ramp. Seeing `WARN kvcache.prewarm: seed_miss=0.37 tenant=tenant-apac-retail region=apac-sg`. Initiating targeted kv prewarm job and enabling fallback.route for impacted tenants.

mike: Good call on fallback. I recommend a staged partial rollback: revert tinybatch.window and routing.weights but keep model.pin and fallback.route. This should limit tail spikes while keeping compatibility pinned. Proposed command: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7975312345 --targets tinybatch,routing --staged true --reason "apac kvcache tail"`

riley: Running staged partial rollback now. Notifying release-coordinator and CS with a short blurb for release notes and customer impact. Will keep the fallback.route in place and run prewarm for 20 minutes before retry.

deploy-bot: Staged partial rollback initiated. Step 1: restore tinybatch.window to 50ms. Step 2 (pending): revert routing.weights if metrics don't return to baseline in 10m.

ops-bot: Fallback route enabled for tenant-apac-retail to dedicated-pool. Traffic split: 85% normal -> 15% dedicated for that tenant.

anj: After prewarm run (5m) 99p down to 680ms, seed_miss=0.11. Keeping routing.weights unchanged for now, but holding canary at 2% for another 10m.

mike: Sounds good. I'll draft a short release-note line: "cfg-7975312345 — timeout and batch optimizations; model pinned to v1.4-stable; partial routing rollback after APAC kvcache prewarm; temporary fallback for affected VIP tenants." Adding to the release doc now.

release-coordinator: Thx. We'll ship that note with the postmortem snippet if we reattempt tomorrow. Marking as held rather than rolled back fully for audit.

riley: Canary still paused at 2%. Monitoring for 10m then decide on ramp cadence. Thanks all.

deploy-bot: Staged partial rollback completed at 7975312378. Canary held. Rollback summary: tinybatch.window restored, routing.weights pending revert if not recovered, model.pin retained (v1.4-stable), fallback routes in place for VIP tenants. Next: finish prewarm window and update release notes."
